# SINGULANCE public overviews

These are page overviews, not complete article or policy text.

## SINGULANCE — AI workforce that runs inside memory

SINGULANCE brings organizational memory, digital teammates and voice agents together. HIVEMIND connects company knowledge; HyperAgents work with that context; TARA supports voice conversations.

Full page: https://singulancelabs.com/

## SINGULANCE Research

Read research on persistent agent memory, cognitive swarm intelligence and post-quantum cryptography. Explore the papers and their supporting methods.

Full page: https://singulancelabs.com/research

## ICARUS — an agent memory filesystem

ICARUS explores a single-file agent memory architecture combining vector, entity, temporal and graph retrieval. The research page describes the design and evaluation.

Full page: https://singulancelabs.com/research/icarus

## Cognitive Swarm Intelligence

Explore the architecture of agents working with shared organizational memory, and the relationships between knowledge, retrieval and coordinated work.

Full page: https://singulancelabs.com/research/cognitive-swarm-intelligence

## Post-Quantum Cryptography

Read the research on hybrid post-quantum transport, memory-write signatures and tamper-evident audit chains, including the underlying standards and implementation.

Full page: https://singulancelabs.com/research/post-quantum-cryptography

## HIVEMIND Memory Benchmarks

Review the published memory retrieval evaluation, its methods and results. Benchmark claims should be read alongside their evaluation conditions.

Full page: https://singulancelabs.com/benchmark

## Privacy Policy

Read how SINGULANCE handles personal data and connected services, and learn about your privacy rights. The full policy is available on this page.

Full page: https://singulancelabs.com/privacy

## Security

Review SINGULANCE’s published security information for organizational memory and AI agents.

Full page: https://singulancelabs.com/security

## Cookie Policy

Learn about essential storage and optional analytics. Manage your consent through the privacy choices available on the website.

Full page: https://singulancelabs.com/cookies
